**Cardiovascular**:

↑Abdominal compartment pressure results in:

→ Initial auto transfusion of splanchnic blood  with transient ↑in VR/Preload 

→  compression of the IVC and splanchnic venous system resulting in reduced venous return →↓ preload

→ Compression of abdominal arterial vasculature Increases systemic vascular resistance and reduced blood flow to abdominal and retroperitoneal organs

**Dose dependant effect on MAP**

- IAP \<20mmHg → ↑SVR outweighs ↓ VR → ↑ mAP
- IAP \>20mmHg → ↓VR→↓CO outweighs ↑SVR  → ↓mAP

Effect on Heart 

↑Work stroke performed due to ↑ afterload and contractility 

**Hypercapnia**

CO2 highly soluble and is absorbed into systemic circulation 

Buffer mechanism of ↑CO2 results in ↑H+/↓pH 

↑CO2 requires ↑MV to compensate 

Resp effects of ↑CO2 

- potentiation hypoxic pulmonary vasoconstriction 
- Respiratory acidosis 

Cardiovascular effects 

- ↓ pH 
- pulmonary vasoconstriction 
- pH \~7.2-7.4 → ↑inotropy, pH \<7.2 ↓inotropy
